description: what the talk window may do — the window the terminal is split out into, built on request rather than declared in tauri.conf.json, so it matches by label at runtime. The folder dialog is here because the terminal face is the same face in either window: a frame with no folder yet asks for one wherever it is drawn, and a window that could not open the dialog would be a face with no way in. Kept apart from the board's so the theme stays removable (delete the window and its permissions leave with this file)
